blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Special Theory of Relativity) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Explain that all motion is relative. Describe the experiment of a ball dropped inside a train compartment (i) when the train is at rest and (ii) when it moves with uniform velocity vₒ, and state what it shows. (5 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke har harkat nisbati (relative) hai. Train ke compartment mein ball girane ka tajurba (i) jab train saakin ho aur (ii) jab yaksaan velocity vₒ se chal rahi ho, bayan karein aur batayein is se kya sabit hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Harkat relative hai: Simt observer par munhasir hai; aap daayen ball phenkein to saamne wale ko woh baayen jaati dikhti hai. Sukoon aur harkat bhi observer par munhasir hain: chalti train ki deewarein musafiron ko saakin magar zameen wale ko harkat mein nazar aati hain. Hum nahi keh sakte ke koi jism mutlaq saakin hai ya harkat mein; har harkat observer ya frame of reference ke lehaz se hai.

Tajurba: Band compartment mein observer compartment ko apna frame maanta hai. Woh ball girata hai aur us ka horizontal faasla naapta hai; har case mein amoodi girne ka waqt t aik jaisa hai.

Case (a), train saakin: Ball ki horizontal velocity zero hai, is liye horizontal faasla bhi zero. Ball chhorne wale point ke bilkul neeche girti hai (Fig. 11.1-a). Andar aur bahar wale dono aik hi cheez dekhte hain.

Case (b), train yaksaan velocity vₒ se: Chhorte waqt ball ki horizontal velocity vₒ hoti hai aur woh projectile ki tarah chalti hai. Waqt t mein woh vₒt horizontal faasla tay karti hai. Train aur andar wala observer bhi itna hi faasla chalte hain, is liye andar wala ball ko bilkul neeche girta dekhta hai. Bahar wala observer ball ko projectile raaste par dekhta hai (Fig. 11.1-b).

Nateeja: Aik doosre ke lehaz se yaksaan velocity se chalte frames ke observers aik hi harkat ko mukhtalif dekhte hain.

book_ref.quote: An observer in a closed train compartment uses the compartment as his frame of reference.

blocks.prompt:
2 A train moves with a uniform velocity of 20 m s⁻¹. A passenger drops a ball which takes 0.6 s to reach the floor. Find the horizontal distance moved by the ball (i) for an observer on the ground and (ii) relative to the point below the release point, for the passenger. (3 marks)
(Train 20 m s⁻¹ ki yaksaan velocity se chal rahi hai. Musafir ball girata hai jo 0.6 s mein farsh tak pohanchti hai. Ball ka horizontal faasla nikalein (i) zameen wale observer ke liye (ii) musafir ke liye, chhorne wale point ke neeche wale point ke lehaz se.)
blocks.explanation: Ball ke paas train ki horizontal velocity rehti hai; train aur musafir bhi utne hi waqt mein utna hi faasla chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: It travels a horizontal distance vₒt in time t it takes for the ball to reach the floor.

steps: Zameen wala observer: horizontal faasla = vₒt = 20 × 0.6 = 12 m
Train aur musafir bhi 0.6 s mein vₒt = 12 m chalte hain
Musafir ke lehaz se faasla = 12 m − 12 m = 0 m: ball bilkul neeche girti hai
blocks.final_answer: (i) 12 m, projectile raaste par; (ii) 0 m, ball bilkul neeche girti hai

blocks.prompt:
3 State the two postulates of the special theory of relativity. Using them, explain time dilation: define proper time, write the equation for the dilated time and show that a moving clock runs slow. (5 marks)
(Special theory of relativity ke do postulates bayan karein. In ki madad se time dilation samjhayein: proper time ki definition, dilated time ki equation likhein aur dikhayein ke harkat karti ghari aahista chalti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Postulates:
1. Physics ke qawaneen tamam inertial frames mein aik jaise hain (Principle of Relativity). Is liye mutlaq yaksaan harkat maloom nahi ki ja sakti.
2. Khala mein roshni ki speed tamam observers ke liye aik jaisi hai, source ya observer ki harkat se be-niaz (Principle of Constancy of Light); c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. c mustaqil hai, is liye space aur time relative ho jaate hain.

Waqt mutlaq nahi: Special theory ke mutabiq waqt frame of reference ki harkat par munhasir hai.

Proper time: Inertial frame mein saakin observer usi frame ke do events ka darmiyani waqt naapta hai. Yeh waqfa tₒ proper time hai.

Dilated time: Agar observer events ke frame ke lehaz se relativistic velocity v se chale (ya frame observer ke lehaz se), to woh tₒ nahi balke
t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) ... (11.1)
naapta hai.

Harkat karti ghari aahista: √(1 − v²/c²) hamesha aik se kam hai, is liye t, tₒ se zyada hai; relative harkat se waqt phail gaya. Yeh tamam processes par laagu hai, physical, chemical aur biological; budhapa bhi aahista hota hai. Misaal: 0.8 c se chalte jahaz mein musafir ke liye 1 s ka event bahar wale ke liye taqreeban 1.7 s leta hai.

book_ref.quote: Suppose an observer is stationary in an inertial frame and measures the time interval between two events in this frame.

blocks.prompt:
4 An unstable particle lives for 2.0 μs when at rest. It moves through a laboratory at 0.96 c. Find (i) its lifetime as measured in the laboratory and (ii) the distance it travels in the laboratory before it decays. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Aik ghair-mustahkam zarra saakin halat mein 2.0 μs zinda rehta hai. Yeh laboratory mein 0.96 c se chalta hai. Nikalein (i) laboratory mein us ki umar (lifetime) (ii) tootne se pehle laboratory mein tay kiya faasla. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Saakin umar proper time hai; laboratory dilated time naapti hai, aur faasla = speed × waqt.

book_ref.quote: the time measured by the observer will not be

blocks.prompt:
5 What is length contraction? Define proper length, write the relation for the contracted length, state the direction in which contraction occurs, and illustrate it with an example. (5 marks)
(Length contraction kya hai? Proper length ki definition, contracted length ka rishta, contraction ka rukh bayan karein aur misaal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Length contraction: Harkat karte spaceship ka observer Zameen se sitare tak faasla Zameen wale observer se kam naapta hai. Agar aap mustaqil faasle wale do points ke lehaz se harkat karein to un ka faasla saakin halat se chhota nazar aata hai. Isi asar ko length contraction kehte hain.

Proper length: Jism ke lehaz se saakin observer ki naapi hui lambai (ya do points ka faasla) proper length ℓₒ hai.

Rishta: Agar jism aur observer speed v se relative harkat mein hon to contracted length
ℓ = ℓₒ√(1 − v²/c²) ... (11.2)
√(1 − v²/c²) aik se kam hai, is liye ℓ, ℓₒ se kam hai.

Rukh: Length contraction sirf harkat ke rukh mein hota hai; amoodi rukh mein nahi.

Misaal: Saakin halat mein 100 m lambi train 0.8 c se chalti hai. Andar wala 100 m naapta hai. Patri ke kinare wala
ℓ = 100 × √(1 − 0.64) = 100 × 0.6 = 60 m naapta hai.

book_ref.quote: The distance from Earth to a star measured by an observer in a moving spaceship

blocks.prompt:
6 A spaceship is 80 m long at rest. Find (i) its length measured by an observer at rest when it flies past at 0.6 c and (ii) the speed at which this observer would measure its length as 40 m. (3 marks)
(Aik spaceship saakin halat mein 80 m lamba hai. Nikalein (i) jab yeh 0.6 c se guzre to saakin observer us ki lambai kitni naapega (ii) kis speed par observer us ki lambai 40 m naapega.)
blocks.explanation: 80 m proper length hai; (i) ke liye ℓ = ℓₒ√(1 − v²/c²) seedha aur (ii) ke liye ulta lagayein.

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain how the mass of an object varies with its speed according to the special theory of relativity. Use the relation to show what happens as v approaches c, and explain why Newton's laws still work in everyday life. (5 marks)
(Special theory of relativity ke mutabiq jism ka mass speed ke saath kaise badalta hai, wazahat karein. Rishte se dikhayein ke jab v, c ke qareeb jaye to kya hota hai, aur batayein ke rozmarra zindagi mein Newton ke qawaneen kyun chalte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Mass badalta hai: Jism ka mass us ki speed par munhasir hai. Saakin halat ka mass rest mass mₒ hai; speed v par mass barh kar m ho jata hai:
m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) ... (11.3)
√(1 − v²/c²) aik se kam hai, is liye m, mₒ se zyada hai.

Matlab: Mass ka barhna tez raftaar par inertia (jumood) ka barhna hai. Jab v, c ke qareeb ho to speed badalne ke liye zyada force chahiye.

Had v → c:
Jab v → c, v/c → 1, is liye √(1 − v²/c²) → 0
Yani m → ∞
La-mehdood mass ko accelerate karne ke liye la-mehdood force chahiye jo maujood nahi, is liye koi jism khala mein roshni ki speed c tak accelerate nahi ho sakta.

Rozmarra zindagi: Rozmarra speeds c ke muqable mein bohat kam hain. Zameen ki orbital speed bhi sirf 30 km s⁻¹ hai jabke c = 300,000 km s⁻¹, is liye m ≈ mₒ aur Newton ke qawaneen durust hain. c ke qareeb chalne wale subatomic zarraat mein relativistic asraat numayan hain aur Einstein ki equations chahiye.

book_ref.quote: According to the special theory of relativity, the mass of an object is a variable quantity

blocks.prompt:
8 A body has a rest mass of 5.0 kg. Find (i) its mass when it moves at 0.6 c and (ii) the speed at which its mass would be 2.5 times its rest mass. (3 marks)
(Aik jism ka rest mass 5.0 kg hai. Nikalein (i) 0.6 c par us ka mass (ii) kis speed par us ka mass rest mass ka 2.5 guna hoga.)
blocks.explanation: (i) ke liye m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) seedha lagayein; (ii) mein m/mₒ = 2.5 rakh kar v nikalein.

book_ref.quote: will have an increased mass m when observed to be moving at speed v

blocks.prompt:
9 Starting from Einstein's relation E = mc², obtain the expressions for (i) rest mass energy, (ii) relativistic kinetic energy and (iii) the change in mass Δm for a change in energy ΔE. What does the last result tell us about nuclear reactions? (5 marks)
(Einstein ke rishte E = mc² se shuru kar ke (i) rest mass energy (ii) relativistic kinetic energy aur (iii) energy ki tabdeeli ΔE ke liye mass ki tabdeeli Δm ke formulas haasil karein. Aakhri nateeja nuclear reactions ke baare mein kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Mass aur energy alag cheezein hain magar aik doosre mein badal sakti hain. Jism ki kul energy E aur mass m ka rishta
E = mc² ... (11.4)
hai, jahan m speed par munhasir hai.

(i) Rest mass energy: Saakin halat mein m = mₒ, is liye rest mass ke barabar energy
Eₒ = mₒc²

(ii) Kinetic energy: Harkat karte jism ka m, mₒ se zyada hai, is liye mc², mₒc² se zyada hai. Farq (mc² − mₒc²) harkat ki wajah se hai aur yahi kinetic energy hai:
K.E. = mc² − mₒc² = (m − mₒ)c²

(iii) Mass ki tabdeeli: Eq. 11.4 se energy ki tabdeeli ΔE mass ko itna badalti hai:
Δm = ΔE/c²

Matlab: c² bohat bari miqdaar hai, is liye mass mein thori tabdeeli energy mein bohat bari tabdeeli hai. Rozmarra energy tabdeeliyan itni kam hain ke mass ki tabdeeli naapi nahi ja sakti, magar nuclear reactions mein energy aur mass ki tabdeeliyan in equations ke bilkul mutabiq paayi gayi hain.

book_ref.quote: mass and energy are distinct entities but are interconvertible

blocks.prompt:
10 A body of rest mass 0.20 kg moves at 0.6 c. Find its (i) rest mass energy, (ii) total energy and (iii) kinetic energy. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹) (3 marks)
(0.20 kg rest mass wala jism 0.6 c se chalta hai. Us ki (i) rest mass energy (ii) kul energy (iii) kinetic energy nikalein. (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Pehle chalta hua mass nikalein; phir Eₒ = mₒc², E = mc² aur K.E. = (m − mₒ)c².

book_ref.quote: As mc² is greater than mₒc²

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain the relativity of simultaneity with the example of a train fitted with light-operated doors. Then use the hypothetical spaceship journey to a star to show how observers on the Earth and in the spaceship explain the shorter journey time. (5 marks)
(Roshni se khulne wale darwazon wali train ki misaal se relativity of simultaneity samjhayein. Phir sitare tak spaceship ke farzi safar se dikhayein ke Zameen aur spaceship ke observers kam safar ke waqt ki wazahat kaise karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Relativity of simultaneity: Mukhtalif jagahon par do events jo aik observer ke liye aik waqt hon, doosre harkat karte frame ke observer ke liye aam tor par aik waqt nahi hote. Simultaneity observer ke frame par munhasir hai.

Roshni wale darwazon wali train: Light ka switch chhat ke darmiyan hai aur compartment ke beech khara musafir use chalata hai. Train roshni ki aadhi speed se chal rahi hai aur musafir light jalata hai. Roshni aage peechhe barabar speed se jaati aur dono darwazon tak aik saath pohanchti hai, is liye musafir dono darwaze aik saath khulte dekhta hai. Bahar wala observer pichhla darwaza pehle khulta dekhta hai, kyunke pichhla darwaza roshni ki taraf aur agla us se door ja raha hai.

Farzi spaceship safar: Spaceship roshni ki aadhi speed se sitare tak jata hai aur Zameen ke observer ke mutabiq 8 saal leta hai.
Zameen ka nazariya: spaceship ki ghariyan aahista chalti hain (time dilation), is liye wahan Zameen se kam waqt guzarta hai.
Musafiron ka nazariya: safar ki lambai sukar gayi hai (length contraction), is liye woh kam waqt mein tay karte hain.
Dono mutafiq hain: musafir 8 ki bajaye taqreeban 7 saal record karte hain (8 × √(1 − 0.25) = 6.9 saal).

book_ref.quote: For the spaceship occupants, the length of the journey has contracted

blocks.prompt:
12 A spaceship travels to a star at 0.6 c. Observers on the Earth find that the journey takes 15 years. Find (i) the time recorded by the occupants and (ii) how much less they age than people on the Earth during the journey. (3 marks)
(Aik spaceship 0.6 c se sitare tak jata hai. Zameen ke observers ke mutabiq safar 15 saal leta hai. Nikalein (i) musafiron ka record kiya hua waqt (ii) safar ke dauran woh Zameen walon se kitna kam boodhe hote hain.)
blocks.explanation: Zameen ka waqt spaceship ki ghariyon ka dilated time hai; musafiron ka waqt √(1 − v²/c²) ke factor se kam hai.

book_ref.quote: Let a spaceship be travelling to a star with half of the speed of light.
